name: Taiji
author: Abstract Games factory (game by Néstor Romeral Andrés, 2007)
description: Taiji (Néstor Romeral Andrés, 2007): every turn you place one TAIJITU — a domino with one light half and one dark half — on two empty orthogonally adjacent squares, choosing which square gets which colour. You are always playing BOTH colours, so every placement also helps your opponent. Seat 1 is Light and starts; seat 2 is Dark. When no domino fits any longer, each player sums the sizes of their N largest same-coloured orthogonal groups (N = 1, 2 or 3; 2 on the standard 9x9 board) and the higher total wins.
